text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened on a day I was out shopping 
for training gear with Almond Eye...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer. Would you mind if we 
made a short detour?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"There's something I want to buy for 
myself. What do you think?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ai-chan♡ Ehehe~ What is it, what's 
up~?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
!? Pandora-san...! No, I was just doing a 
little shopping.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Shopping~!? Nice, sounds great~! I'll come 
along with you ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go, let's go!☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hmm, doesn't look like it's here...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Looking for clothes, Ai-chan? Leave it to 
me! I'll find the absolute perfect outfit 
for you~♡"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. Though I'm not actually 
looking for clothes today.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so...? Ah, then how about 
accessories?! That works too, I'll teach 
you all the latest trends☆"
choice_data_list: They're really fussing over you, huh?

They're really fussing over you, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Pandora-san is always 
looking out for me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Not done yet. Next up are the 
applied linear function problems...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Found Ai-chan☆ What's up? You look 
totally fired up~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a bit... I came in 2nd in the grade 
on the last test. Next time, I'm 
definitely taking 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, all this just for getting second 
place?! Aren't they being, like, waaaay 
too proud of me...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then I'll help out too☆ I'll be 
doing homework right next to you, so just 
ask if there's anything you don't get.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I don't wanna look at homework 
anymore~. Hey, hey, can we go to a 
cafe~...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
P-Pandora-san?! It's only been ten 
minutes!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I'll keep you company. Let's 
finish up before we head out. Okay?
choice_data_list:
Isn't Ai the one taking care of it in the 
end...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, you think so? Well, Ai-chan being 
suuuper sweet is totally legit, though☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-chan is super-duper sweet♡ Thanks for 
everything, luv ya so much~~~♡♡♡"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...No. This much is fine, really.
choice_data_list:
(Something really does seem off, doesn't 
it...?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That last shop was no good... Please, let 
me find it here...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! What are ya lookin' for, 
Ai-chan~? Tell me, tell me! I'll help you 
out ☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Umm, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, there it is! Thank goodness, I 
found it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What caught Almond Eye's gaze was a 
necklace shaped like a golden, shimmering 
butterfly.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! That necklace, it's the new arrival! 
It looks so, so good on you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Ai-chan, you like this too? Ehehe, 
that kind of makes me happy♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...No. You see, this isn't mine.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora. I have a present for you... 
I wonder if you would accept it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Huh? Whaaaat!? Wait, wait, why!? How 
come!?!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: After all, I am truly grateful to you—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can keep working hard without 
overdoing it is all thanks to you, Miss 
Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You know how much I hate losing, right? So 
I ended up pushing myself a bit too hard—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But, thanks to Pandora-san, I was able to 
take a breather so many times.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
When I'm alone, I always end up pushing 
myself too hard... but you've saved me 
time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I want to properly express my gratitude 
to you. Thank you, Pandora-san!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Ai-chan...!
choice_data_list:
You're really supporting each other, 
aren't you?

You're really supporting each other, 
aren't you?

How about Ai invites you out for a break 
next time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Ai-chan...!
choice_data_list:
You're really supporting each other, 
aren't you?

You're really supporting each other, 
aren't you?

How about Ai invites you out for a break 
next time?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, maybe so. ...Perhaps we might just 
be indispensable to each other.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So, Pandora-san... I'm counting on you 
from now on too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*...! Yeah, of couuurse! 'Cause I'll 
always wuv you, Ai-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds great! In that case, the 
cafe I spotted the other day might be 
nice. I was thinking Pandora-san would 
love it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll go, I'll go! If it's with Ai-chan, 
I'd go anywhere~!
